title: Social Media Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your personal data from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms. Protect your privacy with this letter.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request your personal data from social media platforms, understand what information they collect, and exercise your privacy rights under GDPR and other data protection laws.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: Data Protection Officer
[PLATFORM_NAME]
[PLATFORM_ADDRESS]

From: [YOUR_FULL_NAME]
[YOUR_ADDRESS]
[YOUR_EMAIL]
[YOUR_PHONE]

Re: Request for Personal Data Access and Privacy Information

sections.heading: Account Identification and Legal Basis
sections.content:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request access to my personal data held by [PLATFORM_NAME] under my rights as a data subject. My account details are as follows:

Account Username/Handle: [USERNAME]
Account Email: [ACCOUNT_EMAIL]
Approximate Account Creation Date: [CREATION_DATE]
Account ID (if known): [ACCOUNT_ID]

This request is made under applicable data protection laws, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 15, California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other relevant privacy legislation.

sections.heading: Specific Data Categories Requested
sections.content:
I specifically request access to the following categories of personal data you process about me:

1. All profile information, posts, comments, messages, and content I have shared
2. Data about my connections, followers, following, and social interactions
3. Location data, IP addresses, and device information collected
4. Advertising profile data, interests, and behavioral analytics
5. Third-party data sources and data sharing arrangements
6. Login history, security events, and account access logs
7. Content I have viewed, liked, shared, or interacted with
8. Any automated decision-making or profiling data
9. Data retention schedules and deletion policies applied to my data
10. Records of data breaches or security incidents affecting my information

sections.heading: Data Processing Information Request
sections.content:
In addition to my personal data, I request information about:

• The purposes for which my personal data is processed
• Categories of personal data being processed
• Recipients or categories of recipients of my personal data
• Details of any international data transfers and safeguards
• Retention periods for different categories of data
• Information about automated decision-making, including profiling
• The source of personal data not collected directly from me
• My rights regarding rectification, erasure, restriction, and portability

Please provide this information in a commonly used, machine-readable format such as JSON, CSV, or XML files.

sections.heading: Identity Verification and Delivery Method
sections.content:
I understand you may need to verify my identity before processing this request. I am prepared to provide:

• A copy of government-issued photo identification
• Verification through my registered account email or phone number
• Additional security questions or verification methods you require

Please deliver the requested information via:
☐ Secure email to: [DELIVERY_EMAIL]
☐ Postal mail to the address above
☐ Through your platform's data download feature
☐ Secure file transfer (please provide instructions)

I request confirmation of receipt of this letter within 72 hours and the complete response within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws.

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Response Timeline
sections.content:
Please note that this request is made under my legal rights as a data subject. If you cannot comply with this request, please provide specific legal grounds for any refusal and information about my right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority.

If you require additional information to locate my data or verify my identity, please contact me promptly at [CONTACT_INFO].

I look forward to your timely response.

Sincerely,

[SIGNATURE_LINE]
[YOUR_FULL_NAME]
[DATE]
